dashboard.welcomeDesc: A simple app to manage jobs, customers, quotations, invoices and receipts — all in one place. Let's get started quickly.
dashboard.statsDesc: See how many jobs are active, how many were completed this month, and total revenue — all from one screen.
dashboard.quickActionsDesc: Tap these buttons to instantly create a new job, add a customer, or generate an invoice — no need to dig through menus.
dashboard.recentJobsDesc: Your 10 most recent jobs appear here. Tap any job to see full details, related quotations and invoices.
dashboard.menuDescMobile: Tap the menu icon (☰) at the top left to open all modules: Jobs, Customers, Quotations, Invoices, Receipts and Reports.
dashboard.menuDescDesktop: All modules live in the left sidebar — Jobs, Customers, Quotations, Work Orders, Invoices, Receipts, Reports and Settings.
dashboard.helpDesc: Stuck? Tap the ❓ icon at the top anytime to replay the tutorial for the page you're on.
dashboard.flowDesc:
Follow this order for the best results:

1️⃣ Customers — register customer details
2️⃣ Jobs — open a new job for the customer
3️⃣ Quotations — send a price offer
4️⃣ Work Orders — work instructions for your team / sub-con
5️⃣ Completion Reports — proof the work is done
6️⃣ Invoices — bill for payment
7️⃣ Receipts — auto-generated after payment

Let's get started! 🚀

jobs.introDesc: After registering a customer, open a new "Job" for each project. From a single job, every other document flows: Quotation → Work Order → Completion Report → Invoice → Receipt.
jobs.searchDesc: Type a job number, title or customer name to find it fast.
jobs.statusDesc: Tap a tab to view jobs by stage: Lead, Scheduled, In Progress, Completed or Cancelled.
jobs.newDescMobile: Tap the round + button at the bottom to create a new job. The job number is generated automatically.
jobs.newDescDesktop: Tap "New Job" to create a new project. Pick the customer, category and date — the job number is generated automatically.
jobs.afterDesc:
Open the job detail page and follow the order:
3️⃣ Quotation → 4️⃣ Work Order → 5️⃣ Completion Report → 6️⃣ Invoice → 7️⃣ Receipt (auto).

The job status updates automatically based on the documents you generate.

jobDetail.introDesc: This is where you manage EVERY document for a single job, in order: Quotation → Work Order → Completion Report → Invoice → Receipt.
jobDetail.customerDesc: The customer was selected when this job was created. Their details appear automatically in every document below.
jobDetail.jobDesc: This job is created. Now it's time to generate the related documents in the correct order.
jobDetail.quotationDesc: Start with an official price offer. Add work items, quantities, prices, discounts & SST — totals are calculated automatically. Send via WhatsApp so the customer can accept or reject.
jobDetail.workOrderDesc: Once the customer agrees to the quotation, generate a Work Order — formal work instructions for your team or sub-contractor. Includes the task list, dates & terms.
jobDetail.reportDesc: When the field work is done, generate a Completion Report. Add before/after photos, work notes and the customer's signature as proof of completion.
jobDetail.invoiceDesc: When ready, convert the quotation to an Invoice with one click — all items move over automatically. Send the invoice via WhatsApp with a short link (Tap here).
jobDetail.receiptDesc: When the customer uploads payment proof and you confirm it (or you mark it manually), the invoice becomes PAID and the receipt is generated automatically. Tap "Share Receipt via WhatsApp" to send it to the customer.
jobDetail.voDesc: If the customer asks for extra work or wants to remove items mid-job, create a Variation Order (VO). Pick type: Variation (add) or Deduction (subtract). After the customer accepts the VO, the items can be imported into the Invoice with one tap and shown in grouped sections (Original / Variation / Deduction).
jobDetail.financialDesc: The job page shows: Original Quote + Variations − Deductions = Final Total. Live snapshot of the real billable amount for this job.
jobDetail.autoStatusDesc: Job status (Lead → In Progress → Completed) changes itself based on the documents you generate. You focus on the actual work — the system handles the paperwork.

customers.introDesc: This is the FIRST step in the WorkTrace workflow. Register customers first, then you can open jobs, quotations, invoices and receipts for them.
customers.searchDesc: Search by name or phone number. Easy to find old customers for repeat jobs.
customers.tagsDesc: Mark VIP or Repeat customers with tags. Tags help you spot important customers at a glance.
customers.newDesc: Tap to register a new customer. The phone number matters — it's used to send invoices and receipts via WhatsApp.
customers.tipDesc: Once registered, you can pick the customer directly when creating a new job. No need to retype names and numbers.

quotations.introDesc: After registering a Customer (1) and opening a Job (2), send a formal price offer to the customer. Once they accept, continue to Work Order and Invoice.
quotations.statusDesc: Tabs to filter: Draft (not yet sent), Sent, Accepted or Rejected.
quotations.searchDesc: Search by quotation number or customer name.
quotations.newDesc: Tap to create a new quotation. Pick the job, add items with prices and quantities — totals are calculated automatically including SST.
quotations.flowDesc: Create → Send via WhatsApp → Customer accepts → Generate Work Order (Step 4) → Convert to Invoice (Step 6). Job status updates automatically.

quotationDetail.introDesc: Here you can edit, send and convert this quotation into an invoice.
quotationDetail.sendDesc: Tap the WhatsApp button to send the quotation PDF link directly to the customer. They can accept or reject through the link.
quotationDetail.convertDesc: Once the customer agrees, tap "Convert to Invoice" — all items move over to a new invoice. Quick and easy.

workOrders.introDesc: After the quotation (Step 3) is accepted, generate a Work Order — formal work instructions for your team or sub-contractor. Then continue to the Completion Report (Step 5).
workOrders.searchDesc: Search by work order number, job title or customer name.
workOrders.statusDesc: View work orders by status: Draft, Sent (delivered to the team), Accepted or Rejected.
workOrders.howDesc: Work orders are generated from the job detail page. Go to Jobs → pick a job → tap "Generate Work Order".

invoices.introDesc: After the Completion Report (Step 5), it's time to request payment. The invoice is the official bill to the customer. Once paid, the Receipt (Step 7) is generated automatically.
invoices.statusDesc: Status tabs: Draft, Sent, Paid and Overdue (highlighted in red).
invoices.searchDesc: Search by invoice number or customer name.
invoices.newDesc: Create a new invoice from scratch, or — easier — convert from an accepted quotation. Items move over automatically.
invoices.paymentDesc: Your bank details and payment QR appear on every invoice. Set them up first under Settings → Payment Methods.

invoiceDetail.introDesc: This is the invoice control center. You can send the invoice, request payment proof, confirm payment, and share the receipt — all from here.
invoiceDetail.sendDesc: Tap "Send Invoice" to WhatsApp the customer with a short link (Tap here). The link lets them view the invoice and upload payment proof.
invoiceDetail.requestDesc: Not paid yet? Tap "Request Payment Proof (WhatsApp)" to send the customer a reminder with an upload link.
invoiceDetail.verifyDesc: When the customer uploads proof, it appears at the top. Tap "Verify & Mark as Paid" — the invoice becomes Paid and the receipt is generated automatically.
invoiceDetail.shareDesc: Once paid, a new button appears: "Share Receipt via WhatsApp". Tap it to send the receipt to the customer in one click.
invoiceDetail.manualDesc: Customer paid in cash or by bank-in without uploading proof? Tap "Mark Manually" to mark it as paid yourself.

receipts.introDesc: This is the LAST step in the workflow. Every paid invoice appears here as a receipt. Receipts are generated AUTOMATICALLY — no manual work needed.
receipts.summaryDesc: See the total number of receipts and total cash collected — at a glance.
receipts.searchDesc: Search by receipt number, invoice number or customer name.
receipts.howDesc: Go to Invoices → pick an invoice → tap "Mark as Paid" or "Verify Proof". The receipt appears here instantly with an automatic receipt number.

reports.introDesc: See how your business is doing — revenue, completed jobs, new customers and more. Perfect for monthly reviews.
reports.presetsDesc: Tap a pill to choose the report period: This Week, This Month, 3 Months, This Year, or set a custom date range.
reports.exportDesc: Tap to download the report as a PDF — great for record keeping or sharing with your accountant.
reports.tipDesc: Reports are calculated from invoices with PAID status. Make sure all paid invoices are marked correctly.

support.introDesc: Got an issue or a suggestion? Submit a ticket here and our team will help you as quickly as possible.
support.newDesc: Tap to submit a new ticket. Pick a category (Bug, Billing, Suggestion, Account or General) and describe your issue.
support.afterDesc: You'll get a notification when the admin replies. Tap a ticket in the list to view the conversation and reply back. Support is available in English and Bahasa Malaysia.

settings.introDesc: Set this up once — after that, your details will appear automatically on every document, invoice and WhatsApp message. Let's go through them one by one.
settings.profileDesc: Fill in company name, phone, address, logo and SSM number. This info appears on EVERY quotation, invoice, work order and receipt. Tap to open and edit.
settings.paymentDesc: Add bank accounts and payment QR codes. Set one as "Primary" — it becomes the default on invoices. Customers will see how to pay on every invoice.
settings.termsDesc: Edit T&C separately for Quotations, Invoices and Work Orders. There are tabs inside — pick a document, edit text, save. The T&C appears at the bottom of the PDF.
settings.whatsappDesc: Customize greetings & closings for ALL your WhatsApp message types — Quotation, Invoice, Reminder, Work Order, Job Report, Receipt and Follow-up. Pick a template from the dropdown, edit, and see a live preview. The detail sections (numbers, totals, links) are locked automatically so your message is always accurate.
settings.docNumDesc: Set the number format (e.g. INV-2026-001, QUO-0001). Pick the prefix, number length and starting number. The system generates numbers automatically based on your format.
settings.tipDesc:
Each accordion can be opened/closed by tapping its title. Your open/closed choices are remembered for next time.

Once these settings are set up, you're fully ready to use WorkTrace. Happy business! 🎉
